canonicalization.collision_rule: full bytes define equality/order; the SHA-256 digest is an identifier for the serialization, not the equality oracle
canonicalization.column_key: the complete 6-scalar frozen column byte string, not a hash
canonicalization.scalar_encoding: Canonical sidecar binding requires finite IEEE-754 binary64 values serialized little-endian. No rounding, normalization, reordering, or scientific transformation is permitted.
canonicalization.serialization: domain-separated, length-delimited sequence containing ontology/version, primitive digest, d, N, then sorted state-pair records with multiplicity

equivalence_relation.definition: (Theta,a) is equivalent to (Theta P, P^-1 a) for any column-permutation matrix P; equivalently, the multiset of pairs (full frozen column bytes, participation status) is identical.
equivalence_relation.duplicate_columns: Permutations of byte-identical frozen columns are gauge-equivalent. The canonical state therefore uses multiplicities of (full-column-bytes,status) pairs.

operational_gauge.definition: At candidate binding time, the exact ordered frozen sidecar Theta supplies operational slots 0..N-1. These slots are addresses within one bound representation, not intrinsic semantic entities.
